h1: Premium+ Interior Design Package — Maximum Project Detail and Design Support

blocks.text: Premium+ Interior Design Package — Maximum Project Detail and Design Support

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) offers the Premium+ Interior Design Package for apartments, private houses, and commercial spaces where maximum design detail, extended technical documentation, and professional support during project implementation are required.

The package includes all Premium services, plus 2 months of design supervision, custom furniture drawings, complete specifications of finishing materials, and schedules covering all key interior items.
Premium+ is the most comprehensive DUMSKAYA DESIGN format for clients who want not only an interior concept and technical documentation, but also professional designer support during implementation.
What Is Included in the Premium+ Package
1. All Premium Package Services

The package includes all standard and extended Premium services: measured floor plan, functional space planning, furniture layout, demolition and construction plans, electrical layouts, lighting plans, plumbing plans, ceiling and flooring plans, extended wall elevations, detailed construction nodes and sections, specifications, and calculations of key materials.
Photorealistic 3D visualizations are also developed, with up to two rounds of revisions included, as well as two joint visits with the designer for the selection of finishing materials.
2. Two Months of Design Supervision
The package includes 2 months of design supervision.

The designer helps monitor whether the work being carried out corresponds to the approved interior design project, advises on implementation issues, and helps resolve project-related questions that arise during renovation.
This helps reduce the risk of deviations from the approved concept and maintain the integrity of the interior throughout implementation.
3. Custom Furniture Drawings
A set of furniture drawings is prepared for custom-made furniture planned within the project.
This is especially important for kitchens, wardrobes, walk-in closets, built-in storage systems, wall panels, cabinets, shelving, and other custom-made furniture elements.
Furniture drawings help connect the architecture of the property, the interior design, and the future furniture into one coordinated system.
4. Complete Finishing Material Specifications
The project includes extended specifications of finishing materials used in the approved concept.
These may include flooring, tiles, porcelain stoneware, paint, decorative finishes, wall panels, and other materials required for implementation.
This helps create a more complete list of required items in advance and simplifies procurement.
5. Schedules for Interior Items
The package also includes schedules for the main items used in the interior.
These may cover furniture, lighting, plumbing fixtures, decorative elements, textiles, equipment, and other items specified in the project.
This approach provides a more complete overview of the property’s furnishing and simplifies preparation for implementation.
Photorealistic 3D Visualization
Photorealistic 3D visualizations are developed for each main room.
They allow you to evaluate the future interior in advance, including combinations of materials, furniture, lighting, color, textiles, and decorative elements.
The package includes up to two rounds of revisions to the developed visual concept.
This allows the interior to be refined in greater detail before renovation begins.
Extended Technical Documentation
Premium+ includes the most comprehensive set of documentation for interior implementation.

In addition to standard working drawings, the project may include extended wall elevations, detailed construction nodes and sections, custom furniture drawings, finishing material specifications, and schedules for interior items.

This level of detail is particularly important for technically complex properties with a large number of custom solutions, built-in furniture, non-standard structures, and multiple finishing materials.
The more detailed the project, the fewer decisions need to be made directly on site during renovation.
Design Supervision
One of the key advantages of Premium+ is 2 months of design supervision.
During implementation, the designer remains involved in the project and helps the construction team and client follow the approved design concept.

Design supervision may include consultations on project decisions, clarification of individual details, checking whether works correspond to the project, and support when quick project-related decisions are required on site.
This is especially useful for complex interiors where maintaining implementation accuracy and avoiding unplanned design changes is important.
Custom Furniture Within the Project
Furniture plays an important role in the architecture of a modern interior, which is why Premium+ includes dedicated custom furniture drawings.
This allows the dimensions, location, appearance, and main construction principles of individual pieces to be developed in advance.

If required, DUMSKAYA DESIGN can additionally manufacture the designed furniture, including kitchens, wardrobes, walk-in closets, wall panels, built-in storage systems, and other custom-made furniture.
What Types of Properties Is the Premium+ Package Suitable For?
The package is suitable for apartments, private houses, investment properties, offices, salons, shops, showrooms, and other commercial spaces.

It is particularly suitable for properties with complex architecture, a large amount of custom furniture, non-standard materials, complex technical solutions, and high requirements for implementation accuracy.
Each project is developed individually, taking into account the architecture of the property, its size, function, budget, and the client’s requirements.
Who Is the Premium+ Package For?

The package is suitable if you need the most comprehensive interior design project, want to reduce the number of independent decisions required during renovation, and prefer to have professional designer support during implementation.
It is also a strong choice if the project includes a large amount of custom furniture, non-standard solutions, complex material junctions, or requires extended furnishing documentation.
Premium+ is designed for clients who want a complete system: from the interior concept and technical documentation to furniture drawings, specifications, and implementation support.
What You Receive

As a result, you receive a comprehensive interior design project including functional space planning, furniture layout, photorealistic 3D visualizations, an extended set of technical drawings, wall elevations, construction nodes, sections, custom furniture drawings, finishing material specifications, and schedules for interior items.
The package also includes up to two rounds of revisions to the visual concept, two joint visits with the designer for finishing material selection, and 2 months of design supervision.
The project becomes a detailed guide for implementation and helps translate the approved concept into the finished interior as accurately as possible.
Premium+ Interior Design Package Price
€70/m²
Minimum package price — €3,500.
The final price depends on the size of the property, number of rooms, complexity of the architectural and interior solutions, the amount of furniture documentation, and the required level of detail.
How Is Premium+ Different from Premium?

The Premium Package includes an advanced interior design project with detailed technical documentation, specifications, two rounds of visualization revisions, and two joint visits with the designer for material selection.
Premium+ additionally includes 2 months of design supervision, custom furniture drawings, complete finishing material specifications, and schedules for all key interior items.
While Premium provides a high level of preparation for renovation, Premium+ adds more control and professional support during the actual implementation stage.
Additional Services

If required, Premium+ can be supplemented with a detailed renovation cost estimate, full project procurement, purchasing of selected items, custom furniture production, delivery and installation, as well as complete turnkey renovation.
This makes it possible to continue working with one contractor after the design stage and move directly into full interior implementation.
Interior Design in Bratislava and Vienna
DUMSKAYA DESIGN works with residential and commercial properties, combining interior design, photorealistic visualization, technical documentation, custom-made furniture, and implementation support.
The studio’s main geographic focus is Bratislava and Vienna. We also work on projects in other cities across Europe and the USA.
DUMSKAYA DESIGN (Bratislava, Slovakia) — interior design, technical planning, custom furniture, and complete interior implementation.
Order the Premium+ Interior Design Package

If you need the most comprehensive interior design project with deep technical development, custom furniture documentation, specifications, and professional support during implementation, Premium+ provides the most complete interior design service format.
